body.title: fix: use printf in the default shell probe so macOS /bin/sh works
body.body:
The default-shell probe for non-host backends uses echo -n bash. On macOS, /bin/sh is bash 3.2 in POSIX mode, which prints -n bash\n

printf is POSIX and unambiguous. Probe output tested with dash (Debian, Ubuntu), bash (Fedora), BusyBox ash (Alpine, BusyBox; falls back to sh) and macOS: unchanged everywhere except macOS, where it's now correct.

body.title: fix: don't panic when a cancelled job runs composite post steps
body.body:
Post steps of a cancelled job run on a fresh context with no job error container, so SetJobError panics and kills the runner process along with every other job it is running.
